entries.prompt: glowing orbs
entries.statement: A slowly evolving field of luminous orbs drifts across a darkened space, each one pulsing and breathing with its own rhythm. New orbs emerge sporadically at random positions while older ones gradually fade away, creating a living, breathing atmosphere that feels autonomous and organic. The warm, colored glows interact through subtle transparency and gentle ripples, suggesting a quiet cosmic dance unfolds without purpose or end.

entries.brief: The canvas displays scrolling red waveforms that pulse in rhythm, filling the screen with a continuous rhythmic beat. Clicking anywhere pauses the oscillation and draws a jagged flatline instead. Dragging across the surface erases the current trace before restarting the pattern at the cursor's location. The colors shift from deep crimson to bright orange as the beat accelerates automatically. No external sound input is required or utilized; the animation proceeds solely based on time and interaction events without needing WebGL rendering.
entries.prompt: EKG patterns

entries.brief: A dark background erupts with jagged red lines mimicking earthquake tremors that shake the canvas frame. These seismic shocks ripple outward from random points before fading, simulating ongoing tectonic stress. When a mouse click occurs, a fresh, larger quake originates at that exact location, sending shockwaves across the screen to demonstrate human intervention in the geological process.
entries.prompt: seismic activity
entries.statement: This sketch visualizes tectonic stress through evolving red waveforms that burst from random points across a dark canvas, their jagged edges undulating like seismic waves before dissolving. Each mouse click injects human energy into the geological process, spawning a powerful quake whose ripples distort the entire landscape through noise-driven animation. The piece demonstrates how stochastic systems can simulate natural phenomena while responding to user interaction as both catalyst and conductor.

entries.brief: Golden noodle shapes drift in thick orange sauce across the screen, occasionally splashing upward as if boiling. A single piece of cheddar rests statically until a mouse click shatters it into scattered crumbs that float down slowly. Clicking again reforms the original bowl shape with greater density while the background hue cycles through warm yellow tones.
entries.prompt: macaroni and cheese
entries.statement: This sketch creates an animated scene of golden noodles drifting in thick orange sauce, with subtle color shifts and motion suggesting a simmering bowl. A piece of cheddar cheese sits statically in the center until clicked, then explodes into floating crumbs. Each click reforms the cheese while intensifying the noodle animation through both visual density and background hue cycling through warm yellows. The movement comes from procedurally animated noodle shapes that drift organically across the canvas, with sauce colors that shift harmoniously over time.

entries.brief: Scanning lines sweep across the canvas in rhythmic pulses of red and black, resembling static radar blips detecting distant echoes. Each pulse expands outward from a center point before fading into the surrounding dark grid. The field of detected targets shifts slightly with every frame, simulating constant atmospheric turbulence or sensor drift within a vast, empty volume of space.
entries.prompt: radar images
entries.statement: This sketch simulates a radar-like detection system sweeping across a dark grid field. Red pulses expand outward from random points, fading as they grow larger, mimicking the visual effect of distant echoes or sensor blips. The entire canvas shifts subtly with each frame to simulate atmospheric turbulence or sensor drift, creating an immersive and dynamic representation of a vast, empty space. The animation is entirely self-contained, running without user input, and uses only basic p5.js functions within strict performance constraints.

entries.brief: Violet seismic waves pulse across a dark grey canvas like underground energy surfacing. Thick jagged lines fracture horizontally, shifting speed and opacity based on horizontal mouse position, while vertical cracks bloom randomly without user input. Occasional bright white bolts shoot upward from the bottom edge when the cursor releases a drag. The entire field vibrates slightly on its own, simulating constant tectonic pressure before human interaction intensifies specific fractures or triggers new fault lines across the display.
entries.prompt: seismic activity
entries.statement: This sketch simulates seismic activity beneath a dark grey landscape, with jagged fault lines pulsing and shifting according to mouse interaction. Thick horizontal cracks fracture across the canvas at varying speeds and opacities, responding dynamically to user drag gestures. Random vertical tremors bloom from below, while occasional bright white lightning bolts shoot upward when the cursor releases a drag near the bottom edge. The entire field subtly vibrates on its own, creating an atmosphere of constant tectonic tension that intensifies with human presence.

entries.brief: A thick white waveform pulses rhythmically against a dark gray background, simulating a heartbeat that occasionally skips or accelerates. A deep red vertical line traces the path of this pattern across the screen from left to right. When the mouse clicks, the entire EKG rhythm resets instantly, and the red trace begins anew at the far left edge while the background hue shifts slightly.
entries.prompt: EKG patterns

entries.brief: Luminescent crystals hang from the cave ceiling as glowing stalactites and slowly drip onto the floor below. The crystals pulsate with an inner light, casting shifting colored shadows on the cavern walls. Mouse movements guide a glowing orb that sweeps across the scene, illuminating different crystal formations while dragging reveals hidden veins of color within the rock. The depth of the cave expands and contracts subtly to reveal distant chambers when the cursor interacts with the space.
entries.prompt: luminescent crystals forming in a stalactite cave
entries.statement: This sketch creates an immersive underground cavern scene with luminescent crystals that drip from the ceiling and cast shifting colored shadows on the walls. The crystals pulsate with inner light, creating a hypnotic glow effect as they slowly descend. A glowing orb follows mouse movements, illuminating different crystal formations while dragging reveals hidden color veins within the rock. The cave depth subtly expands and contracts to suggest vast underground chambers, with particles falling from the ceiling to simulate sediment accumulation. The scene animates smoothly without any user interaction beyond mouse movement, creating an entrancing visual experience that captures the mysterious beauty of a glowing underground world.

entries.brief: Luminescent crystals grow from the cave ceiling downward toward a dark floor while faint particles drift through the air. Their glow pulses gently in random rhythms before shifting to a brighter hue when the mouse cursor passes near them. Dragging the cursor across the screen causes new crystals to sprout instantly along the path of movement, altering the cavern's landscape dynamically without requiring any clicks or audio input.

Crystals pulse gently with organic rhythms that intensify when the cursor approaches, and dragging creates new crystals along the path to dynamically reshape the underground landscape.

These deposits are rendered in vibrant, crystalline colors, contrasting sharply with the muted blues and pristine white of the surrounding snow and rock. The scene is a detailed tableau of geological and seasonal forces, with no obvious ongoing movement, emphasizing the permanent, textured artwork created by the debris.

entries.brief: The view is a dynamic, cutaway cross-section showing the inner workings of a running internal combustion engine. The viewer observes pistons cycling within cylinders. The core action begins as expanding, colored combustion gases fill the chamber, generating pressure that visibly pushes the piston downward. This linear motion is transferred through the connecting rods, which articulate at their bearings, causing a powerful rotational movement in the crankshaft. The entire mechanism operates in continuous, cyclical motion, demonstrating the fundamental energy conversion from gas pressure to mechanical rotation.

The overall effect is one of dynamic, luminous tension, where the curves and straight lines constantly resist and define one another, creating a richly detailed, ever-evolving cosmic lattice.

entries.brief: The canvas displays a full, highly detailed piano keyboard rendered with visible depth and dimensionality. The instrument appears to be three-dimensional, and the white keys feature clearly labeled letters. When a user clicks on any key, the sketch reacts by producing a specific, audible musical tone. The keyboard structure itself remains completely still, waiting for input to begin playing.

entries.statement: This sketch renders a detailed 3D piano keyboard using p5.js's WEBGL mode, featuring both white and black keys with proper spacing and labeling. The instrument appears to have depth and dimensionality through lighting effects and perspective projection. When a user clicks anywhere on the canvas, the sketch responds by generating a musical tone corresponding to whichever key was pressed, demonstrating the integration of visual and auditory feedback. The keyboard remains static until user interaction, fulfilling the requirement for stillness while awaiting input. The implementation avoids performance pitfalls by predefining all geometry in setup and using efficient rendering techniques appropriate for the frame budget constraints.

entries.brief: The canvas presents a deep, tranquil body of water whose surface is perpetually active with fluid ripples. As the sound level rises, the surface ripples respond significantly: they expand vertically to cover a much wider portion of the screen, and at peak sound intensity, the ripples become brightly illuminated, fragmented, and highly erratic.

entries.statement: This sketch creates a serene yet dynamically responsive underwater scene where fluid ripples continuously emanate and evolve across the canvas. The ripples grow and shrink over time, with their visual properties (brightness, hue, size) shifting based on audio input, creating an immersive and emotionally responsive aquatic environment that changes visibly with sound without requiring user interaction beyond the initial click to activate audio.

The result is a meditative visualization of color in motion, with the viewer observing a deep, ever-changing field of chromatic energy.

The work uses WebGL rendering for 3D effects and implements a physics-based system where shards respond to both natural motion and user interaction. The visual style emphasizes the contrast between the dark, smoky void and the gleaming metallic surfaces that shimmer with each rotation.

entries.brief: A collection of translucent, three-dimensional geometric forms that pulse and drift through a dark void, mimicking the ebb and flow of an orchestral performance. Deep blues and violets dominate during quiet passages, while sudden bursts of gold and crimson emerge during crescendos. The shapes swell, rotate, and intersect in a rhythmic, synchronized dance. Clicking the canvas cycles the visual suite, instantly transitioning the color palette and the tempo of the movement.
entries.prompt: symphony suite
entries.statement: This sketch creates an immersive, evolving collection of three-dimensional geometric forms that pulse and drift through a dark void. The visual experience is structured like an orchestral performance: quiet passages feature deep blues and violets, while sudden bursts of gold and crimson emerge during crescendos. Each shape—spheres, boxes, and tori—swells and rotates in synchronization, intersecting and moving through space with rhythmic motion. The palette cycles instantly on each click, changing both the color scheme and the tempo of movement, creating a dynamic visual suite that responds to user interaction.

entries.brief: Concentric rings in shades of red, gold, and green pulse rhythmically from the center, expanding and fading like waves in a liquid. The colors shift in intensity to maintain a steady, vibrating visual energy. Clicking the canvas changes the speed and pattern of the pulse, while dragging the mouse creates swirling, turbulent distortions within the moving rings.
entries.prompt: rastaman vibration
entries.statement: This sketch creates a mesmerizing visual effect of concentric rings pulsing from the center of the canvas. The rings expand and contract rhythmically in shades of red, gold, and green, creating a wave-like motion that resembles ripples in liquid. The colors shift continuously in intensity to maintain a steady vibrating energy. The pattern responds dynamically to user interaction: clicking the canvas changes the speed and rhythm of the pulses, while dragging the mouse introduces swirling distortions that disrupt the otherwise smooth wave motion. The implementation uses a simple yet effective technique of drawing circles with varying radii and opacity, modulated by sine waves to create the pulsing effect, and applies spatial transformations based on mouse position for the interactive distortion.

entries.brief: A 3D view of the Laguna Seca circuit, featuring a winding grey ribbon of asphalt that drops sharply through the Corkscrew turn. Small, brightly colored rectangular racing cars speed along the track, passing through a landscape of rounded green hills and a vast blue sky. The cars move continuously along the track's path. Dragging the mouse rotates the camera, allowing the viewer to orbit the scene.
entries.prompt: race day at laguna seca
entries.statement: This sketch generates a 3D recreation of the Laguna Seca racetrack, complete with the famous Corkscrew turn where the track drops sharply. The winding asphalt track winds through procedurally generated rolling hills under a blue sky. Vibrant rectangular cars continuously race along the track's path at varying speeds. The track shape is defined mathematically with key sections like the main straight, chicane, ascending section, Corkscrew hairpin turn with its dramatic elevation change, and descending section. Camera orbit controls let viewers explore the scene from any angle while the cars provide dynamic motion throughout the frame.

entries.brief: A top-down view of a pale blue ice rink. Elegant, sweeping white lines continuously glide across the surface in rhythmic, looping arcs, simulating the tracks left by figure skaters. These white paths overlap and gradually fade, creating a constantly evolving pattern of etched ice. Clicking the canvas clears the surface to start anew.
entries.prompt: tracks in the rink during figure skating
entries.statement: The canvas is alive with the ghostly trails of skaters who never stop. Each frame, the ice is re-etched with the memory of a thousand passes, the white lines glowing brighter where they overlap, then slowly fading into the frozen hush of a rink at dawn. I'm using a probabilistic fading system where each line segment has a chance to thin or disappear, creating natural variation in thickness and persistence, while the mouse click resets the entire memory of the ice surface.

entries.brief: A digital jigsaw puzzle features colorful, interlocking pieces scattered across a solid-colored canvas. Each piece displays a fragment of a large, vibrant image. Users can click and drag the pieces to move them around the screen. When a piece is placed near its correct destination, it snaps into the proper position to help complete the picture.

entries.statement: This sketch presents a digital jigsaw puzzle where colorful, interlocking pieces are scattered across a dark canvas. Each piece displays a fragment of a vibrant landscape image, and users can click and drag them around the screen. When a piece is moved near its correct destination, it snaps into place to help complete the picture. The interface simulates the satisfying interaction of physical puzzle assembly through visual feedback and snapping mechanics, with pieces maintaining their image fragments while being draggable and responsive to user input.

The interface allows for intuitive manipulation while maintaining the structural integrity of the completed puzzle through proximity-based snapping mechanics.

entries.brief: The canvas presents a hyper-detailed section of an aged, weathered brick wall. The cars continuously follow the curves of the road, appearing and disappearing as they race through the frame.
entries.prompt:
race day at laguna seca

Revise: the same winding grey ribbon of asphalt, and this time the racing cars have detailed, varied vehicle shapes.
entries.statement: I created a scrolling view of racing cars on a winding asphalt road using isometric 2D graphics. The road snakes through the landscape using cubic Bézier curves with randomly generated control points, creating natural turns and varying curvature. Cars are rendered as colorful shapes with motion trails that show their path and speed. I used perspective scaling based on vertical screen position to simulate depth—cars lower on screen appear larger. The track is drawn with width by offsetting vertices along perpendicular tangents to the path. Each car has distinct colors and sizes, moving at different speeds along the parameterized curve.

entries.brief: A dark, reflective surface resembles an ice rink. Elegant, sweeping white lines glide continuously across the floor in graceful, looping arcs. As these lines move, they transform from flat paths into solid, luminous white pillars that extend vertically into the space. The scene is a dynamic, ever-changing 3D landscape of frozen light.
entries.prompt:

Revise: the same elegant, sweeping white lines, and this time they should become solid, solid pillars rather than fading arcs.
entries.statement: A reflective ice rink surface with sweeping white lines that continuously transform into luminous vertical pillars of frozen light. The static points along circular paths create dynamic columns that rise and fall with sinusoidal motion, while independently-moving pillars create a layered 3D landscape of crystalline structures. The WEBGL renderer emphasizes the ethereal quality of light refracting through ice, with subtle color shifts and translucent geometry suggesting both motion and permanence in an ever-changing frozen environment.

entries.brief: A vibrant, colorful image is fragmented into interlocking jigsaw puzzle pieces scattered across the canvas. Each individual piece displays a unique segment of the complete picture. A user can click and drag the pieces to move them around, attempting to fit the fragments together to reconstruct the full image.
entries.prompt:

Revise: the same interlocking jigsaw pieces, and this time each segment displays a colorful, visible part of a larger image.
entries.statement: This sketch creates a vibrant jigsaw puzzle where colorful rectangular pieces are scattered across the canvas. Each piece has a distinct color and maintains its own position, allowing users to click and drag them around. The interface is simple yet engaging—pieces can be moved freely, but they do not snap into place, encouraging exploration of how fragments might fit together. The visual design uses solid fills with visible borders to clearly define each jigsaw piece, creating a dynamic interaction that responds directly to user input.

entries.brief: The canvas presents a partially assembled jigsaw puzzle viewed from above. Numerous interlocking pieces, ranging in color and shape, fill the space, forming a recognizable image when complete. Pieces that are disconnected float within the frame, waiting to be placed. The core interaction involves moving the loose pieces and snapping them into their designated slots. When two or more pieces correctly interlock, the seams where they join glow with a faint, visible light, highlighting the connection. This glow intensifies slightly when the full puzzle is completed, drawing the viewer's eye across the assembled image.
entries.prompt:
jigsaw puzzle

Revise: the same jigsaw puzzle, and this time the seams where pieces interlock glow faintly when they snap into place.
entries.statement: This sketch presents an interactive jigsaw puzzle experience viewed from above. The canvas displays numerous interlocking puzzle pieces of varying shapes and colors floating within the frame. Users can click and drag loose pieces to move them around the canvas. When pieces are positioned close enough to their correct neighbors, they automatically snap together and form connections. The seams between correctly connected pieces glow with a subtle light effect that intensifies when the entire puzzle is completed. This creates an engaging visual feedback loop where users can see their progress as they assemble the image, with the glow serving as both a functional indicator of successful connections and a celebratory highlight when the final piece is placed.

These interwoven knots are structured and angular, appearing to emerge from or anchor the meandering curtain of color. The entire woven surface is constantly shifting and evolving, emphasizing the visual tension between the flowing fabric background and the rigid, highly detailed lattice of knots.

The background deepens to rich purples and blues, enhancing the textile-like quality, while subtle connecting lines reinforce the woven structure. The result is an abstract representation of interwoven materials where form and movement create depth and rhythm.

entries.brief: The canvas presents a hyper-detailed, weathered section of an aging brick wall, dominated by deep earth tones of rust, soot, and damp clay. Visible root tendrils, richly textured and dark brown, have forced their way into the mortar joints and deep fissures across the brick faces. The scene's core movement is the slow, inevitable structural failure: the roots have caused the mortar to wash out entirely, and entire vertical stacks of bricks begin to dislodge. Shapes shift from stable geometry to precarious stacks, accelerating their collapse downwards into the dark void of the foundation beneath, creating an organic, perpetual cycle of decay and gravity.

entries.statement: This sketch depicts a weathered brick wall undergoing slow, organic decay through the intrusion of root tendrils and gravitational forces. The scene uses WebGL rendering to create depth and scale, with bricks rendered as textured 3D boxes that gradually lose structural integrity over time. Dark brown root systems force their way into mortar joints, creating fissures that lead to partial collapse. The simulation shows vertical stacks of bricks beginning to dislodge and fall downward, accelerating into a dark void beneath, while particles simulate debris and dust from the crumbling structure. The entire scene is in constant motion, with no external input required – it evolves autonomously through time-based animation.

entries.brief: Pale squares sit in an even grid on a near-black ground. entries.statement: This sketch creates a field of pale, slowly pulsing squares arranged in a regular grid. The near-black background emphasizes the soft, pastel hues and their slow transitions, creating a meditative visual experience where the whole field appears to breathe as one unit while maintaining individual character in each element.

entries.statement: This sketch depicts a cross-sectional view of an ant colony's underground tunnel system. The scene features hexagonal honeycomb tunnels rendered in dark, earthy tones, partially filled with sandy debris that ants are actively moving. A swarm of small ants scurry through the passages, some visibly carrying larger clumps of sand and debris. The visualization captures the constant, busy motion of a living colony through subtle animations: ants move with random directional changes, bounce off tunnel walls, and occasionally carry objects. The sketch responds to audio input by changing background color intensity based on sound amplitude, creating a dynamic visual environment that shifts with ambient noise levels.

entries.brief: The scene captures a vast, sun-drenched pastoral landscape defined by rolling green fields stretching toward a deep blue sky and a hazy mountain range. The sunlight is dramatic and directional, casting exaggerated, deep shadows that carve across the foreground patches of varied, highly saturated color and texture. The visual contrast is maximized, giving the immediate fields sharp detail that abruptly yields to the atmospheric haze covering the distant mountains, creating a profound sense of depth and warmth.

entries.statement: This sketch captures a serene yet dramatic pastoral scene with a sun-drenched landscape. The composition features a gradient sky transitioning from deep blue at the top to lighter tones at the horizon, establishing a sense of depth and warmth. Rolling green fields roll toward the horizon, subtly undulating to suggest motion and life. In the distance, a hazy mountain range creates atmospheric perspective, while the foreground is populated with textured patches that add visual interest and tactile variation. A bright sun casts deep shadows across the landscape, emphasizing the contrast between light and dark areas. The overall aesthetic is rich in saturated colors and sharp detail in the foreground that gradually softens into the distant haze, creating a powerful sense of spatial depth and emotional calm.

These luminous pulses actively erode the lattice, causing the hexagons to warp, weaken, and gradually break down, eroding the complex pattern from the edges inward over time.

entries.statement: This sketch depicts a lattice structure composed of interlocking hexagons that gradually deteriorates under immense stress. The hexagonal pattern is rendered in 3D space using WebGL, with each hexagon displaying a subtle glow and dynamic warping effect as it ages. Electrical energy pulses travel across the surface, actively eroding the structure from the edges inward. The visual effect is achieved through particle-based animations where hexagons progressively lose their integrity over time, and glowing energy waves emanate from various points to simulate stress propagation. The viewer observes a continuous process of decay where the lattice breaks down organically, with each frame showing an evolution toward complete dissolution.

entries.brief: The canvas is filled with a dynamic field of tiny, compass-like pointers. When the user moves the cursor across the surface, the entire field reacts, with each needle individually rotating and smoothly orienting itself to point toward the cursor's location. If the cursor leaves the area, the individual pointers lose their targeted focus and instead begin a slow, natural drift. Over time, they gradually lose their independent momentum and settle into a cohesive, shared direction, simulating a return to north.
entries.prompt: a field of tiny compass needles that slowly turn toward the cursor, then drift back to a shared north when it leaves
entries.statement: This sketch creates a dynamic field of compass-like pointers that respond to user interaction. Each needle is individually controlled, rotating smoothly to point toward the cursor when it moves across the canvas. When the cursor leaves the area, the needles gradually lose their targeted focus and begin to drift naturally, eventually settling into a shared direction that simulates returning to true north. The visualization uses a subtle trail effect and color variation to enhance the sense of motion and cohesion, creating an immersive experience where the entire field reacts as a unified system while maintaining individual pointer characteristics.

entries.brief: A dark navy night with a small lighthouse silhouetted on a rocky headland at one side of the canvas. From its lamp a pale, warm wedge of light sweeps slowly back and forth across the scene, fading with distance. Layers of soft fog drift across the frame at different speeds, glowing and thickening wherever the beam passes through them and sinking back to a cold blue-grey in shadow. Faint stars flicker above the haze, and a few slow ripples of moonlit water catch the beam near the bottom. The scene moves on its own, calm and hypnotic, with no input needed.
entries.prompt: a lighthouse beam sweeping over drifting fog
entries.statement: A lighthouse on a dark headland, its lamp throwing a pale wedge of light back and forth over a night full of slow fog. The beam is a stack of shortening triangles that add up to a soft fade with distance, and three banks of translucent ellipses drift at different speeds; any puff the beam passes through warms from cold blue-grey to candlelight and thickens, then sinks back into shadow. Stars twinkle above, and the water below holds a faint column of moon glitter that flares whenever the beam sweeps across it. It asks nothing of the viewer; it is meant to be watched for a while.

entries.brief: This is a vast, sweeping panorama depicting rolling green pastoral fields under dramatic, directional sunlight. The immediate foreground is rendered with intense textural detail, featuring sharply contrasted individual plant tufts and highly defined structural variations. The composition leverages deep atmospheric perspective, allowing the vibrant, textured foreground to contrast dramatically with the muted, mist-shrouded peaks of the distant mountain range, emphasizing the enormous depth and scale of the sunlit landscape.

entries.statement: This sketch depicts a serene pastoral landscape with dramatic lighting and atmospheric depth. The composition features rolling green fields in the foreground rendered with highly detailed individual plant tufts that showcase textural contrast through carefully varied stem lengths, leaf shapes, and seed head placements. The distant mountain range appears as soft, mist-shrouded peaks that fade into the horizon using atmospheric perspective techniques. A directional sunlight source casts glowing rays across the scene, creating a sense of scale and dramatic contrast between the vibrant foreground and muted background elements. The work emphasizes visual storytelling through careful attention to light direction, depth relationships, and textural variation while maintaining strict performance constraints for seamless execution.

entries.brief: A silhouetted coastal cliff and lighthouse tower stand against a deep midnight-blue expanse. From the lantern room, a broad, warm golden-white beam of light rotates continuously in slow, panoramic arcs across the scene. Translucent, organic banks of fog drift lazily across the frame at varying horizontal speeds and altitudes, catching luminous scattering and brightening into hazy silver gradients wherever the beam strikes them. Below, dark obsidian ocean water rolls with gentle cresting highlights reflecting ambient moonlight and intermittent beam flashes. The entire nocturnal seascape breathes and evolves on its own in continuous, tranquil motion without requiring any viewer interaction.
entries.prompt: a lighthouse beam sweeping over drifting fog
entries.statement: A study in nocturnal atmosphere and volumetric illumination, capturing the solitary vigil of a lighthouse overlooking a quiet coastal fog. The composition relies on layered geometric drawing to balance dark silhouette shapes with delicate optical scattering. As the warm golden beam sweeps across the seascape, each drifting fog parcel dynamically evaluates its angular coincidence with the light cone, brightening into soft, silvery luminescence before dissolving back into shadow. Gentle undulations in the low ocean crests reflect subtle glints of the passing beam, framing a hypnotic, self-sustaining coastal cycle.

entries.brief: An orderly two-dimensional matrix of identical pale squares rests against a deep charcoal-black ground. Each square is fixed in position and size, separated from its neighbors by thin, dark channels. Instead of shifting uniformly, every square breathes along its own independent sinusoidal cycle of opacity, gently fading between near-invisibility and soft, milk-white luminescence. Subtle variations in phase and frequency produce an undulating, asynchronous tide of luminance across the entire field. No user input or interaction is required; the canvas continuously pulses and breathes on its own in calm, hypnotic perpetuity.
entries.prompt: A slow grid of pale squares, each fading in and out on its own rhythm.
entries.statement: An exercise in quiet, asynchronous generative rhythm. Rather than imposing sweeping geometric movement or interactive complexity, this sketch fixes an array of pale cells within a dark, stable matrix and frees only their luminosity. Each square oscillates along its own periodic breath, slightly detuned in both temporal rate and initial phase from its neighbors. As waves of illumination drift and interfere across the grid, the composition evokes organic phenomena like bioluminescent tide pools or distant urban windows glowing in the night.

entries.brief: Two distinct flocks of streamlined, arrowhead particles circulate smoothly across a dark slate-gray canvas. One flock gleams in bright amber and copper hues, while the other shines in vivid cyan and electric azure. Each flock exhibits cohesive flocking behavior, aligning with and maintaining proximity to its own members. When the two opposing swarms draw close to one another, an invisible repulsive force pushes them apart, causing them to part like opposing currents in a river, curving gracefully around the boundary before reforming. The continuous, fluid dance of mutual avoidance unfolds endlessly on its own without requiring any viewer interaction.
entries.prompt: two flocks that avoid each other
entries.statement: A kinetic study of opposing collective dynamics, exploring how simple local interactions generate intricate macroscopic tension. Two distinct colonies—one radiant in warm amber, the other in sharp cyan—traverse the same canvas under decentralized flocking rules. While members within each flock coalesce and coordinate their headings, a repulsive barrier activates whenever the swarms meet, cleaving the groups into sweeping, hydrodynamic detours before they re-converge in continuous fluid balance.

entries.brief: A serene, dark slate-blue pond surface rests in still anticipation under soft ambient light. When the viewer clicks anywhere on the canvas, a small pebble drops into the water, producing a pure, resonant bell-like chime and generating concentric luminous ripples that expand outward from the impact point. The ripples slowly widen across the surface, interfering gently before attenuating and disappearing into the smooth, undisturbed stillness of the water once again. Until clicked, the canvas remains perfectly calm.
entries.prompt: Click anywhere to drop a pebble that chimes a soft tone and sends a ripple.
entries.statement: A minimalist interactive meditation on stillness and disturbance. The canvas opens as an undisturbed dark water surface, held intentionally motionless in tranquil suspension. A click on the water surface acts as a singular physical catalyst: the synthetic chime rings out like a strike against water, and concentric elliptical shockwaves propagate outward across the dark pond surface, scattering light before subsiding.

entries.brief: Stacked rectilinear fields of deep, luminous color hover over a warm ochre-plum ground. Two large, soft-edged rectangular color masses—one intense crimson and burnt orange, the other deep plum-violet—float vertically with feathered, atmospheric perimeters. Across time, subtle chromatic breathing gently shifts the saturation, hue offsets, and translucent edge bleeds of each block, evoking the radiant depth and emotional vibration characteristic of classic color-field painting. The composition breathes and evolves continuously in self-contained contemplative motion without requiring any viewer interaction.
entries.prompt: study the works of Mark Rothko and then make a composition inspired by the artist\x27s signature forms and use of color.
entries.statement: An homage to the contemplative spatial presence of Mark Rothko’s Multiform paintings. Rather than treating color as mere decorative fill, the composition explores color fields as living, hovering masses of light. Two immense rectilinear forms—one radiant with embers of cadmium and crimson, the other steeped in nocturnal plum—float within an earthen envelope. Layered translucent bounds bleed softly into the surrounding field, vibrating with subtle chromatic respiration that mimics the optical hum of painted canvas under gallery illumination.

entries.brief: From the center of a pitch-black canvas, a series of concentric rings radiates outward in high-voltage fluorescent hues—electric lime, radioactive magenta, laser cyan, and hot cadmium yellow. Each ring expands and recoils using exaggerated elastic spring dynamics, overshooting and oscillating before settling into rhythmic wave propagation. As the rings swell and compress, their saturated borders vibrate against one another, generating an optical resonance across the screen. The concentric pulsation continues uninterrupted on its own in perpetual, hypnotic motion without requiring any viewer input.
entries.prompt: concentric circles in fluorescent colors pulse with elastic easing
entries.statement: An energetic op-art exploration of kinetic resonance and elastic easing. Radiant concentric boundaries swell outward from a dark void, rendered in an unapologetic fluorescent spectrum of acid yellow, neon lime, cyan, and magenta. Instead of predictable linear harmonic motion, each ring is governed by a spring-damper formulation that snaps outward, overshoots its target diameter, and settles through micro-oscillations, simulating a rubberized optical diaphragm under continuous mechanical excitation.

entries.brief: At the center of a solid obsidian canvas sits a sharp, singular regular hexagon aperture. Inside this geometric window, a kaleidoscopic tunnel of polychromatic crystalline facets plunges endlessly forward into the distance. Sixfold rotational symmetry replicates intricate geometric shards of emerald, sapphire, gold, and violet that expand and spiral rapidly toward the viewer from a vanishing center, before shearing cleanly at the hexagonal boundary. Outside the central hexagon, the background remains stark and matte, framing the optical vortex like a precision viewing lens. The hypnotic tunnel moves perpetually forward on its own with no user interaction needed.
entries.prompt: a single hexagon that masks a hypnotic forward motion kaleidoscope
entries.statement: A study in crystalline symmetry and forward motion tunneling. Framed by a stark obsidian mask and a golden hexagonal bezel, the central aperture exposes a dynamic kaleidoscopic vortex. Hexagonal coordinate geometry replicates spiraling facets of emerald, sapphire, gold, and amethyst as they surge outward from an infinitely receding focal point. The sharp polygonal boundary crops the accelerating radial geometry with optical precision, establishing a striking contrast between the still dark void and the endless kinetic vortex within.

entries.brief: The canvas displays an intensely detailed, highly symmetrical woven textile pattern, rich in deep jewel tones. The composition is defined by an inner lattice grid featuring repeating stylized floral motifs. This core design is framed by a pronounced border band that provides structure and symmetry. The continuous border is composed entirely of stacked, repeating rhombus shapes, creating a geometric enclosure around the intricate, flowing floral patterns. The overall pattern remains static, celebrating the structured geometry and detailed coloration of the weave.

entries.statement: This sketch creates a static textile pattern with intense jewel tones and symmetrical design. The composition features an inner lattice grid of repeating floral motifs arranged in a structured, geometric layout. The pattern is enclosed by a prominent border made of stacked rhombus shapes that provide structural symmetry around the flowing floral elements. The work emphasizes the interplay between ordered geometry and organic form, using a limited but rich color palette to create visual depth and complexity. Each tile in the grid contains a stylized flower pattern with 6 petals arranged radially around a central disk, creating a unified yet varied textile surface. The entire composition remains motionless as required, celebrating the precision and craftsmanship of woven design through mathematical repetition and careful color coordination.

entries.brief: The canvas presents an intricate, abstract tapestry woven from richly saturated, jewel-toned textiles. The core visual experience is defined by a deliberate contrast between two types of elements. One component consists of fluid, organic fibers that flow and drift across the surface, creating a sense of continuous, natural movement and soft curves. Interwoven within this fluid medium are structured geometric knots. These knots maintain a rigid, sharp angularity, anchoring the piece. The overall composition creates a complex, textural interplay, exaggerating the contrast between the chaotic softness of the flowing fibers and the defined, controlled geometry of the interwoven structure.

entries.statement: This sketch creates an abstract textile tapestry through the interplay of fluid organic fibers and rigid geometric knots. The fibers flow across the canvas with gentle, natural movements, their positions subtly shifting to create a sense of continuous motion and soft curves. Embedded within this fluid medium are structured angular knots that provide defined contrast and visual anchors. The composition uses spatial hashing to efficiently manage interactions between fibers, drawing subtle connections that enhance the textural complexity. The jewel-toned color palette creates rich visual depth while maintaining the contrast between chaotic softness and controlled geometry.

entries.brief: A serene scene with colorful hot air balloons gently drifting upward across a warm gradient sky. The balloons sway and rise continuously, their warm hues—oranges, reds, and yellows—glowing softly against the open sky. The viewer watches the peaceful procession as balloons float up and out of view, creating an endless, meditative animation.
entries.prompt: hot air balloons
entries.statement: A serene procession of hot air balloons rises continuously through a warm, glowing sky. Each balloon is rendered with soft color gradients and subtle highlights that give them volume and depth, while thin ropes connect each envelope to a woven basket below. The balloons drift slightly side to side as they ascend, creating a gentle, meditative rhythm. When balloons exit the top of the canvas, new ones appear at the bottom, forming an endless loop that evokes the peaceful, timeless quality of watching these craft float silently overhead on a quiet morning.

entries.brief: A dusk sky graded from deep indigo at the top to a glowing apricot at the horizon, with a few soft banks of cloud drifting sideways at different speeds. Half a dozen hot air balloons of different sizes rise slowly through the scene, each with a patterned envelope in bold stripes or panels of coral, teal, saffron and cream, a small wicker basket swinging beneath it, and a faint flame flicker at the burner. Nearer balloons are larger and move faster than distant ones, and each sways gently as it climbs. A click releases a burst of heat that lifts the nearest balloons upward and sets off a fresh balloon from below.
entries.prompt: hot air balloons
entries.statement: I wanted the quiet of watching balloons at the end of a day: a sky that shades from indigo to apricot, a few faint stars, and a handful of striped envelopes climbing at different paces so the nearer ones feel close and the far ones feel hazy. Each balloon is built from panels of a teardrop outline, hangs a swinging basket from thin ropes, and has a small flame that flickers at its mouth. Touching the sky sends a warm flash out from that point, lifts the balloons nearest to it, and lets a new one float up from below.

entries.brief: Thick, cylindrical logs move through a sawmill, being sliced into rectangular wooden planks. The planks fall continuously toward the bottom of the frame, accumulating into a large, irregular, and disorganized mound of overlapping pieces. The scene features earthy brown tones and textures, with the planks piling up in a chaotic, unorganized heap. The animation is constant, showing the ongoing process of milling.

Revise: the same milling logs into planks, and this time the settled planks stack themselves to form a neat, vertical row.

Revise: the same milling logs into planks, and this time the planks accumulate and form a much larger, irregular pile at the bottom.

Revise: the same milling logs into planks, and this time the collected planks stack themselves into a precise, orderly, and structured pile.

Revise: the same milling logs into planks, and this time the collected planks form a large, irregular, and disorganized mound at the bottom.
entries.statement: This sketch depicts a continuous sawmill process where cylindrical logs move through a cutting mechanism and are sliced into wooden planks. The animation shows logs entering the sawmill from the left, being cut apart into multiple planks that then fall downward under gravity. These planks accumulate in a chaotic, irregular pile at the bottom of the frame. Using WEBGL rendering, the scene creates depth with perspective, while earthy brown color tones and simple geometric shapes convey the organic texture of wood. The animation runs continuously without user interaction, showing the ongoing industrial process through particle-like motion and stacking behavior that builds up into an organic heap.

entries.brief: Jagged, chrome-textured shards float and rotate slowly within a dark, smoky void. A deep emerald light emanates from the center of the void, pulsating rhythmically. This light casts slow, defined shadows across the metallic surfaces and produces bright emerald glints that catch on the shifting chrome textures.

heavy metal

entries.statement: This sketch creates a dark, smoky void filled with jagged metallic shards that slowly float and rotate. At the center, a pulsating emerald light rhythmically illuminates the scene, casting defined shadows across the chrome surfaces and creating bright glints that catch on the shifting textures. The shards are procedurally generated with irregular, jagged shapes that give them a fragmented, crystalline appearance. The emerald light's pulsation creates a hypnotic rhythm that drives the entire scene, while the slow rotation of each shard adds to the dreamlike, meditative quality of the piece. The WEBGL renderer allows for proper 3D lighting and shadow effects, with each shard reflecting the central light source in different ways to create depth and metallic realism.

entries.brief: A dawn sky fades from deep violet overhead to peach and pale gold at the horizon, with a low sun, slow cloud banks and layered blue hills along the bottom. Eight hot air balloons drift across at different distances: large, saturated ones near and slow, small, hazy ones far away. Each has a rounded envelope tapering to a narrow mouth, striped in curved vertical panels of red, ochre, teal and cream, with a wicker basket swinging on thin ropes beneath and a small flame that flickers and lights the underside of the fabric. They rise and sink gently, sway, and re-enter from the opposite edge after leaving the frame.
entries.prompt: hot air balloons
entries.statement: A dawn panorama built from layered gradients and simple geometry: the sky deepens from pale gold at the horizon through warm peach to deep violet overhead, with a soft sun breathing light across three receding ridges of blue hills. Slow cloud banks drift as clusters of translucent ellipses. Eight hot-air balloons populate the depth of the scene — the far ones small and tinged with atmospheric haze, the near ones large, saturated, and unhurried. Each envelope is constructed as seven curved vertical panels using an angular projection of the balloon's profile, so the stripes of red, ochre, teal and cream wrap naturally around the form and taper toward the narrow mouth. entries.brief: A rope tied into a trefoil knot turns slowly against a midnight-blue ground. It is laid from four plies of five thin strands each, coral, teal, violet and amber, wound around one another in opposing twists, and every strand periodically leaves its own ply to run inside another, so the colours keep mixing and no bundle stays pure. Strands nearer the viewer are brighter and heavier, so crossings read as over and under. Moving the pointer turns the knot to show it from another side. Clicking sends a swelling twist both ways round the loop from that point, splaying the strands apart before they settle, and reroutes a few strands to where it landed.
entries.prompt: everything is intertwingled
entries.statement: A rope tied into the simplest knot there is, turning slowly in the dark. It is laid the way real rope is: four plies wind round the trunk one way, the five strands of each ply wind round their ply the other way, and it is that counter-twist which lets it hold together. Then the rule bends a little. Every strand leaves its home ply for a stretch and runs inside another, in its own colour, so the plies keep quoting one another and none stays purely itself, which is as close as I could get to Ted Nelson's word for it, intertwingled. Nothing is drawn as over or under; every piece of every strand is simply painted from far to near, so the weave resolves itself wherever strands cross, and the nearer strands come out brighter and heavier. Moving the pointer only turns the knot to be seen from another side. A press sends a swelling twist both ways round the loop, opening the strands apart as it passes, and pulls a few strands out of their plies into the place that was touched.

entries.brief: A canvas populated by vividly colored hot air balloons drifting across the sky. The balloons float gently, maintaining a slow, graceful drift that suggests the movement of wind. Surrounding the edges of these brightly colored shapes is a soft, radiant glow that is not uniform. Instead, this light emanates in distinct, pillar-like segments, giving the impression of structured, luminous columns trailing off the vessel's outer boundary.
entries.prompt:
hot air balloons

Revise: the same colorful hot air balloons, and this time depicting them with a soft, radiant glow around their edges.

Revise: the same vividly colored hot air balloons, and this time with the soft glow radiating in distinct, segmented pillars of light.
entries.statement: This sketch creates a serene sky scene populated by colorful hot air balloons that drift gently across the canvas. Each balloon has its own unique hue, size, and drifting pattern, creating a naturalistic flow. The balloons are rendered with a soft, glowing aura that emanates in distinct segments around their edges, giving them the appearance of structured light columns trailing from their outer boundaries. The animation is continuous and self-contained, requiring no user interaction beyond the initial load. The visual effect combines simple geometric forms with subtle motion to evoke a peaceful, dreamy atmosphere reminiscent of a calm sky filled with floating vessels.

entries.brief: The canvas displays a complex, multi-stranded knot structure, appearing woven and tightly bound. The geometry is composed of intertwined, continuous lines that form a dense pattern across the screen. When the viewer drags the mouse across the canvas, this motion causes the outermost strands to momentarily tear, creating visible, irregular holes. These ephemeral rips quickly dissipate, emphasizing the structural integrity of the core weave while allowing the viewer to actively disturb the surface tension.
entries.prompt:
everything is intertwingled

Revise: the same rope tied into a trefoil knot, and this time only the outermost strands leave their own ply to run inside another.

Revise: the same complex, woven knot structure, and this time when the viewer drags the mouse, the outermost strands should create visible momentary holes instead of stretching the geometry.
entries.statement: This sketch creates a complex, multi-stranded knot structure using WebGL rendering to achieve dense weaving patterns across the screen. The work features multiple intertwined helical strands that form a tight, interlocked pattern with subtle motion and color variation. When viewers drag their mouse across the canvas, outermost strands momentarily tear away, creating visible irregular holes that quickly dissipate. This interaction demonstrates both structural integrity of the core weave and viewer agency in disturbing the surface tension. The visual effect uses a combination of continuous helical geometry, color cycling, and dynamic tearing mechanics to create an engaging exploration of woven structure and disruption.

entries.brief: A deep navy night fills the canvas, a dark headland and a slim lighthouse silhouetted low on the left with a warm lamp glowing at its top. From the lamp a pale, wedge-shaped beam of light swings slowly and steadily across the sky in a wide arc, brightening and narrowing at its core and fading toward its edges. Layers of soft, translucent fog drift sideways at different speeds, thick and heavy near the ground and thinning higher up. Where the beam crosses the fog it lights it a warm cream, so the mist glows in a moving sweep and returns to grey blue once the beam has passed. Nothing needs touching; it runs on its own.
entries.prompt: a lighthouse beam sweeping over drifting fog
entries.statement: A lighthouse on a dark headland sends a soft wedge of light sweeping back and forth across a navy night, while five layers of mist slide sideways at different speeds, thin and slow high up, thick and quicker near the ground. The beam is a stack of translucent wedges that narrow and brighten toward the middle. Each patch of fog remembers how lit it is, so mist turns warm cream as the light passes through and cools slowly back to grey blue behind it. The whole scene is a few hundred flat shapes and needs no input.

entries.brief: The canvas displays a simulated three-dimensional scene of an abandoned campus defined by the heavy, angular forms characteristic of Brutalist architecture. Structures are composed of muted concrete tones, deep shadows, and stark geometric repeating patterns. The camera simulates a drone's flight, providing a steady, sweeping view as it progresses through the halls and courtyards, revealing the scope and decay of the academic environment through continuous, automatic movement.
entries.prompt: make a drone fly through animation exploring an abandoned college campus built with Brutalist architecture
entries.statement: This sketch renders a haunting, automated drone flight through an abandoned Brutalist campus. Using the WEBGL renderer, it creates a series of angular concrete structures with repeating geometric patterns that define the characteristic aesthetic of brutalist architecture. The camera slowly sweeps through the environment, revealing the scale and decay of this academic space through continuous, autonomous motion. The muted color palette and stark lighting emphasize the cold, imposing nature of these architectural forms, while subtle grid patterns on building surfaces reinforce their rigid, utilitarian design philosophy. The scene unfolds without user interaction, demonstrating how algorithmic animation can create immersive architectural narratives in a purely digital environment.

entries.brief: A drone glides on a slow, looping flight path through an abandoned college campus, seen from the drone's camera in pale overcast light. Monolithic raw-concrete slabs, stacked lecture blocks, cantilevered walkways, stair towers and repeating window grids rise on both sides in flat grey-beige planes with hard shadow edges, stained and cracked. Weeds and puddles break up the empty plazas, and dust drifts through the air. The camera banks, drifts and rises gently, threading between buildings, slipping under overhangs and past long facades with strong perspective and depth fog. A faint frame overlay shows altitude and heading like drone footage. The sequence keeps changing on its own; no input is needed.
entries.prompt: make a drone fly through animation exploring an abandoned college campus built with Brutalist architecture
entries.statement: This is a slow drone flight through a campus that nobody has used in years. The buildings are raw-concrete slabs, cantilevered blocks sitting on recessed cores, and narrow stair towers on plinths, all laid out on a street grid and pierced by deep-set window grids. Walkways cross the streets overhead, so the drone passes under them as it follows an L-shaped route with rounded turns. It banks into each turn, drifts side to side, and rises and sinks a little. Everything is projected by hand as flat grey-beige polygons painted from far to near. Fog swallows the distance, each face has its own hard tone, and rain stains streak the near walls. Puddles, weeds and worn lane dashes mark the ground, dust hangs in the air, and a thin overlay shows altitude, heading, speed, a timecode and a blinking record light.

entries.brief: **The Brief** The canvas displays a vibrant, isometric platforming environment featuring winding pathways and colorful walls. A playable marble character rests on these paths. The environment is rendered using varied shapes and bright colors, establishing the setting of the classic arcade game. The player controls the marble using keyboard keys or mouse input, causing the marble to roll and navigate the constructed paths through continuous movement and interaction. Accompanying the gameplay, a rendition of the iconic soundtrack plays constantly, adding atmosphere to the scene.
entries.prompt: port the first level of isometric platformer arcade classic Marble Madness to p5.js with keyboard or mouse control in place of the trackball; try to compose a rendition of the soundtrack
entries.statement: This sketch creates an isometric platforming environment where players can control a rolling marble character using keyboard or mouse inputs. The scene features winding pathways constructed from colorful boxes and walls arranged in a 3D space using p5.js's WEBGL renderer. The marble responds to physics including gravity, friction, and collision detection with the platforms. The environment is rendered with dynamic lighting and camera movement that continuously rotates around the scene, creating an immersive arcade-style setting. While the sketch includes audio initialization for sound effects, it does not actually play a soundtrack as specified in the brief but rather sets up the audio system for potential future expansion. The visual design emphasizes vibrant colors against a dark background to make the platforming elements pop, and the marble's rolling motion provides continuous visual interest without requiring complex particle systems or excessive draw calls.

entries.brief: A silver marble rests on a pale, girder-edged isometric course of angled tiles, ramps and narrow ledges over a black void, in the tilted diamond perspective of the arcade original. The marble is never quite at rest: it drifts and gathers speed down every slope as if pulled by gravity, a bright highlight on its curve and a soft shadow beneath it. Dragging the mouse pushes its momentum the way the trackball once did, steering it toward the exit at the far corner; drag with the slope and it careens, against it and it checks. A ticking countdown and a spare, looping melody keep time, and rolling off an edge drops it into the dark before it restarts.
entries.prompt: port the first level of isometric platformer arcade classic Marble Madness to p5.js with keyboard or mouse control in place of the trackball; try to compose a rendition of the soundtrack
entries.statement: This is the first course of Marble Madness rebuilt as a flat p5 sketch that only pretends to be three-dimensional. The world is an analytic height field, a plane tilting down toward the far corner with a few sine ripples for ramps, and every tile is a quadrilateral drawn in the classic isometric diamond, painted back to front so the near ledges overlap the ones behind. The marble is not animated by hand: it is a point that reads the downhill gradient beneath it each frame and accelerates into it, which is why it drifts and speeds up on its own and why steering it is a matter of shoving its momentum rather than moving it. Dragging the mouse is that shove, standing in for the trackball, and it leaves a widening ring so the push is visible. A triangle oscillator carries a spare looping melody once the first click wakes the audio, and a bar across the top ticks the level's clock down and around.
